items.q: What types of products can you help me source?
items.a: We specialize in textiles, clothing, furniture, building materials, and industrial goods, thanks to long-standing factory relationships.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses or only large orders?
items.a: We work with both. While bulk sourcing is our main service, we also support startups placing their first container orders.

items.q: How do I know your factories are legit?
items.a: All factories are verified through personal visits and long-term partnerships. No Alibaba resellers or unverified middlemen.
Yes, we provide weekly updates, shipping documents, and photos from our team in China during inspections.
You pay us and we pay the factory, so you never send money to a supplier nobody has visited.

items.q: Which languages do you work in?
items.a: English, Chinese and Arabic. We speak to the factory for you and act as your local representative.

section1.title: Introduction
section1.content: At World Associates Trading Company, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your information when you visit our website and use our services.

section2.title: Information We Collect
section2.intro: We collect information you provide directly to us and information gathered automatically when you interact with our website and services.

item1.title: Contact Information:
item1.desc: Name, email address, phone number, company name, and other details you provide through our contact forms or inquiries.

item2.title: Communication Data:
item2.desc: Messages, documents, and correspondence you exchange with us during the consultation and sourcing process.

item3.title: Usage Data:
item3.desc: Information about how you interact with our website, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, and time spent on our site.

section3.title: How We Use Your Information
section3.intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
section3.item1: To respond to your inquiries and provide consultation services
section3.item2: To facilitate sourcing requests and manage orders
section3.item3: To send service updates and important announcements
section3.item4: To improve our website and services

section4.title: Data Security
section4.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. We encourage you to use strong passwords and contact us immediately if you suspect any unauthorized access to your account.

section5.title: Data Retention
section5.content: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide our services, fulfill your requests, and comply with legal obligations. You may request deletion of your data at any time, subject to applicable laws and our legitimate business needs.

section6.title: Your Rights
section6.intro: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data:
section6.item1: Right to access your personal data
section6.item2: Right to correct or update inaccurate information
section6.item3: Right to request deletion of your data

section7.title: Cookies & Tracking
section7.content: Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze site usage. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

section8.title: Third-Party Links
section8.content: Our website may contain links to third-party websites and services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

section9.title: Contact Us
section9.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us.
